text:
taylor: brainstorm: instead of a 4-panel deep dive, can we ship a compact "snapcard" for the benchmark launch? one image that works as OG + social + webinar slide.

noah_m: curious 10 - what's on the snapcard?

taylor: left third = tiny sparkline showing token latency over seq length (median + p95 markers). middle = single scatter for cost vs latency with color bands for "hosted" and "dedicated". right = stacked micro-waterfall showing unit cost reductions (batching, quant, caching). keep labels ultra-short.

rani: love a single visual. small ask 10: include a micro-annotation showing "burst-friendly" path for <128 tokens so folks building chat UIs see it at a glance.

cleo: data callout idea: show % delta instead of raw cost in the waterfall so it scales across model sizes. e.g., "-70% unit cost" vs exact $ amounts.

noah_m: i'm ok with % but we should also include a single baseline $ for conversion table in the blog copy. numbers from latest run: median=50ms/token, p95=180ms/token, baseline=$0.30/1k, optimized=$0.08/1k. will upload CSV to /marketing/bench/exports by EOD.

taylor: perfect. cleo can you mock two copies: one using % deltas and one with $ so we can test which converts better?

cleo: yes. will post Figma frames. link: https://www.figma.com/file/market-snapcards. will follow brand palette but try a lighter background for OG readability.

ops-bot: Note: OG image min size 1200x630px. Also: keep central text < 60 chars for preview.

rani: copy idea for social: "Faster, cheaper inference without trading quality." variants: short and long.

taylor: alternate: "Ship predictable inference: speed where it matters, savings where it doesn't." shorter than earlier drafts.

sdr-team: routing question 10: when the blog goes live, how do we route inbound demo requests? prefer UTM campaign bench_launch_2026; demo signups -> SDR queue A; enterprise leads -> AE queue.

taylor: yes to UTM bench_launch_2026. we'll add a hidden field in the demo form for "benchmark cohort" so SDRs can prioritize. also add a webinar CTA in the blog copy for deeper dives.

noah_m: webinar notes: 20 min demo + 25 min Q&A with an ops playbook. capture signup source and include a short pre-survey about latency vs cost priorities.

cleo: timeline: Figma draft by tomorrow 11am, csv by EOD, hero copy by taylor by tomorrow noon, blog live target next Tue. can we do a small A/B on headline in the email blast?

taylor: yes. cleo will produce two OG variants (percent vs $). jamie from content will run the A/B.

sdr-team: will prep lead routing rules and tags.

noah_m: one more ask 10: include a tiny footer note "tests performed with open model X on standard GPU" to be transparent.

taylor: good call. keep the footer single line. thanks everyone, let's ship the snapcard and webinar CTA. :rocket:
